originality.rationale: The April 2026 motivating paper explicitly calls imaginary-height residues modulo a period an open question and postpones its solution. The present proof establishes positive lower linear counts in every arc for a co-countable collection of periods and an exact actual-zero phase closure at a resonant fundamental period, with a sharp missing-arc threshold and square-root edge. The paper's geometric phase-feasibility propositions can imply some of the scalar minimization, and no originality is claimed for Kronecker--Weyl or Rouche techniques alone. Moreno (1973), Mas--Sepulcre (2019), and Podesta's February 2026 article treat real/linear zero projections, not quotient-circle actual-zero counts. Historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The April 2026 primary source explicitly motivates density of imaginary zero heights modulo a period as a live open question. This is addressed for a natural entire three-term family not just by existence of a suitable period but by a co-countable full-modular coverage law with positive lower visiting counts. A structurally different natural resonant period has a completely classified forbidden arc, an exact coefficient threshold, and a sharp universal square-root closing law.
